column3: Close to the Hebrew; “he will clear a way” is rendered “he will prepare the way,” and “the messenger of the covenant” “the Messenger of the covenant,” capitalized.
Close to the Hebrew; “the soap of washers” is rendered “launderer’s soap.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will be to Yahweh bringing near an offering” is rendered “That they may offer to the LORD An offering.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a hastening witness” is rendered “a swift witness,” and “those who defraud the hire of a hired worker” “those who exploit wage earners.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “Therefore” before “you are not consumed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the contribution” is rendered “offerings.”
Close to the Hebrew; “until there is no sufficiency” is rendered “That there will not be room enough to receive it.”
Close to the Hebrew; “prove barren” is rendered “fail to bear fruit.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a land of delight” is rendered “a delightful land.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your words have been strong against me” is rendered “Your words have been harsh against Me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “we have kept his charge” is rendered “we have kept His ordinance.”
Close to the Hebrew; “have been built up” is rendered “are raised up,” and “they have escaped” “go free.”
Close to the Hebrew; “those who esteem his name” is rendered “who meditate on His name.”
NKJV renders “on the day when I make [my] treasured possession” as “On the day that I make them My jewels,” and “I will have compassion on them” as “I will spare them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you will return and see” is rendered “you shall again discern.”
